exposure: Naturally conceived twins vs. twins conceived through ART
outcome: Time to achieve optimal nutritive tolerance
cohort: 182 extremely low birth weight newborns (ELBWNs) treated at University Hospital, Pleven, Bulgaria, between 2005 and 2017.
finding: While survival rates were similar, ELBW twins experienced more respiratory, hemorrhagic, and gastrointestinal problems than singletons, leading to more long-term complications, but ART conception did not significantly impact outcomes.
